title: Hydrodynamic and Stochastic Limits of Space-Time Hawkes Processes
summary: We study the large-scale behavior of critical and nearly critical space-time Hawkes processes initialized by a prescribed Poisson field of past events. The density of this initial field separates three macroscopic regimes. In the high-density regime, fluctuations average out and the event measure converges to a hydrodynamic limit which is a deterministic diffusion profile. At the fluctuation threshold, random branching remains visible and produces a measure-valued stochastic limit.
